[Tits metric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0516 1. appi:1.55\group Points at infinity The analogous quotient metric for simply connected complete manifolds of nonpositive curvature is the Tits metric; its metric cone is the Tits cone.
